draft.text: You came in because you have been having right upper quadrant abdominal pain for several weeks.
The pain is described as squeezing and severe, and it gets worse when you eat.
No specific findings were made during the visit, but you mentioned that you have a history of gallstones diagnosed by ultrasound.
Your pain may be related to your gallstones, especially since it gets worse after eating and your family has a history of gallbladder disease.
You will be referred for further evaluation and management of your gallstones.
This may include considering surgery or other treatment options.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have been having severe pain in your right upper belly area for several weeks.
The pain feels like squeezing and gets worse when you eat.
We did not do any tests or exams during this visit.
You have a history of gallstones, which were found by ultrasound.
You have been avoiding high-fat foods, but the pain continues.
You will be referred to a specialist for more evaluation and treatment options.
Possible treatments may include surgery or other options for your gallstones.
